New reader falls back to original for legacy policy; old reader falls back for candidate policy; no cache file is deleted merely because policy differs.
Old Save preserves new policy string. On reupgrade the candidate cache is reusable; an old retranslation invalidates only that cache for the candidate.
No native window is shown or handle created; constructors and PinStore model APIs are the actual product implementations.
